final_message:
**Status:** Reproduced

**Expected:** `<template #_slot2>` replaces the fallback content of `<slot name="_slot2">`, as it does for `#slot1` and as in v3.5.13.

**Actual:** On a9269c64 (main), `#slot1` renders its template, but `#_slot2` renders the fallback ("This is the default slot content for `_slot2`"). I ran the reporter's own SFCs (`App.vue`, `BaseLayout.vue`, `SubComponent.vue` from the playground link, compiled as `<script setup>` with an inline template) and got the reported symptom.

**Trigger:** A component with an underscore-named slot, rendered inside the slot content of a parent whose slots are dynamic. In the report, `<BaseLayout>` has a `<template v-if=... #randomslotname>` next to `<SubComponent>`, and `SubComponent` is given `#_slot2`. Without the `v-if` template the same markup works; I ran that as a control. The slot name `slot1` works in the same render.

**Run:** `npx vitest run -c vitest.unit.config.ts packages/vue/__tests__/underscoreSlotNames.spec.ts`
The new test file has 3 tests. The 2 that exercise the bug fail, and the control passes.

**Reliability:** Deterministic. It failed on 4 of 4 runs, and nothing in it is timing-dependent.

**Likely cause (not fixed):** `assignSlots` in `packages/runtime-core/src/componentSlots.ts` now skips every key starting with `_` when `optimized` is false. Commit 5d166f3 (#13215) changed `key !== '_'` to `!isInternalKey(key)`. A dynamic parent slot is rendered through a BAIL-flagged fragment, so the child component is mounted with `optimized = false`. That drops the user slots `_slot2` and `_duration`. As a check, I temporarily put `key !== '_'` back and all 3 tests passed. I then reverted it.

**Artifacts:** `packages/vue/__tests__/underscoreSlotNames.spec.ts` is the only change in the working tree, and no production code was changed. That was the only file I changed under the repo.

Two things differ from the playground. I ran the report's v3.5.13 SFC variant (`slot1` / `_slot2`); the v3.5.14 variant (`title` / `_duration`) has the same structure. I also compiled the SFCs with `compileScript` in the test rather than through Vite.
